answers.core: This could be made into an add-on to keep the engine lean however, I feel it should be a core component since it completes the set of tools for random generation and as many have said before; one-liner addons are counterproductive.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around using `randf()>0.5` but can be annoying when used often.
